about: Whole-prompt fixture for the UserPromptSubmit suggestion gate (task:444cc036). Each row is a scrubbed, hand-labelled user prompt of the kind the hook sees: terse replies, skill invocations, cross-session messages, boilerplate, plus real requests. Names, ids, tickers, holdings, paths and amounts are replaced with generic text. Prompts were cut at about 60 characters when read from the hook's event log, so long ones end early. expect lists every mac command that would be a right suggestion; [] means no mac command fits and the hook must show nothing. kind records why a row is hard: request (a mac command fits), reply (a short answer to the previous turn), skill (a slash command), boilerplate (a templated message), chat (discussion with no command), news (market or finance talk). The bar: at most 1 in 20 of the suggestions shown may be wrong (task:444cc036).
